name: Terminal Management Additional Process 1 Code
definition: Additional process to perform before starting or after a terminal management action by the point of interaction (POI).

MANC.name: Manual Confirmation
MANC.definition: Manual confirmation of the merchant before the terminal management action.

RCNC.name: Reconciliation
RCNC.definition: Acquirer reconciliation to be performed before the terminal management action.

RSRT.name: Restart System
RSRT.definition: Restart the system after performing the terminal management action.
